subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: For this xAI/Grok stale encrypted_content rotation case, should maintainers accept pre-fix production logs plus targeted positive/negative unit coverage as enough proof to merge this narrow predicate change?
rationale: ClawSweeper cannot safely mark the external PR proof sufficient because no after-fix real Grok/gateway output is present, but the contributor plausibly explains that the exact code-less 400 depends on provider-side key/model rotation and cannot be forced on demand.

options.title: Accept a proof override
options.body: Maintainers explicitly accept the source-level reproduction, pre-fix production logs, and narrow unit coverage as sufficient for this non-inducible provider rotation case, then land after normal rebase and CI gates.

options.title: Wait for organic after-fix logs
options.body: Keep the PR open until an organic xAI rotation event produces redacted after-fix gateway or terminal output showing one stripped retry and recovery.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: If maintainers do not want to relax the proof gate without real after-fix output, leave this PR paused or close it until better provider evidence is available.
